name: Crab Masala
instructions: 1. Clean the crabs thoroughly, remove the shell, and cut into medium pieces. Lightly crack the claws.
2. Heat coconut oil in a deep pan and add cumin seeds and curry leaves until fragrant.
3. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown, then stir in the ginger-garlic paste.
4. Add turmeric, chili powder, and tomato puree, cooking until the oil separates from the masala.
5. Add the crab pieces and stir well to coat them in the spice mixture.
6. Pour in half a cup of water, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes until the crab is cooked.
7. Stir in the fresh coconut milk and garam masala, cooking for another 2 minutes.
8. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with steamed rice or paratha.
description: Crab Masala is a signature coastal delicacy of the Andaman Islands, reflecting the region's abundance of fresh, high-quality seafood. It is a celebratory dish often prepared in local households, showcasing the fusion of traditional Indian spice blends with the tropical flavors of fresh coconut, which is a staple ingredient in island cuisine.
